why: Drops the controller layout pane out of the population `activePanelContainer` derives. The pane exists to be configured with a controller in hand, so losing the D-pad inside it is the one place that cost lands hardest; issue #754 added it and the list had to be edited by hand to keep up. Kept per-pane after the derivation replaced that list, because it pins that THIS pane is swept rather than that some pane is.
killedBy: the controller layout pane (issue #754) is a panel a controller can act in: Confirm with nothing focused lands inside the pane
the controller layout pane (issue #754) a controller's D-pad reaches the same controls, Cancel included while a capture waits
